meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在临时工作区调试具体的 LazyCodex 或 Codex 缺陷，做出最小修复，并附上修复前后的复现与验证日志。属于 LazyCodex 的缺陷产出带补丁的 issue，上游 openai/codex 的缺陷则从 fork 提 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修 bug、贡献 bug 修复，或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。先判断归属：LazyCodex 缺陷提 issue，上游 openai/codex 缺陷从 fork 提 PR。

这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 帮我从 fork 提个 PR

howto.what_en: Claude debugs a concrete LazyCodex or Codex defect in a temp workspace, makes the smallest fix with before/after logs and tests, then delivers a verified-fix issue with the patch (code-yeongyu/lazycodex) or a fork PR (openai/codex).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect. LazyCodex-owned bugs become an issue; upstream openai/codex bugs become a fork PR.

say_en.text: Debug this Codex CLI bug and open a fork PR for it
say_en.note: Reproduce, fix, verify, then PR to openai/codex
